name: Document that frontend_templates/<template>/{js,css,img,fonts} is mirrored to the public templates-assets repository
description:
## Summary

The release job copies the `js`, `css`, `img` and `fonts` folders of templates 00, 07, 09, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 and `shared` from `cms/templates/frontend_templates/` into the public GitHub repository [shoptet/templates-assets](https://github.com/shoptet/templates-assets). Its only cleanup step deletes `*.css` and `*.json`. Anything else placed in those four folders ships to external template developers. Nothing in the templates documentation says so, which is how PR #43773 placed a Vitest file in `00/js/modules/` and had to be reverted (#43944) and re-landed with the test moved (#43950). This task writes the mirror down where developers touching the templates will see it.

## Why?

One test file published by accident already cost a revert and three weeks of review round-trips. The only safeguard today is knowing that the publish script exists. `cms/templates/frontend_templates/README.md` covers only install, dev and build; `AGENTS.md` in the same folder does not mention the mirror at all.

## What?

Add a short "Public mirror" section to both `README.md` and `AGENTS.md` in `cms/templates/frontend_templates/`: which folders are copied, where they land, when it runs, that only `*.css` and `*.json` are stripped, and that tests and other dev-only files belong under `frontend_templates/tests/` or `react/`, never inside `<template>/js`. Documentation only, no change to the publish script.

## Acceptance Criteria

README.md and AGENTS.md name the mirrored folders (

<template>/{js,css,img,fonts}

 for 00 07 09 10 11 12 13 14 shared), the target repository and the trigger (push to 

master-release-**

 touching 

cms/templates/frontend_templates/**

).

Docs state that only 

*.css

 and 

*.json

 are removed before publishing, so every other file type in those folders becomes public.

Docs state where storefront JavaScript tests live (

tests/<template>/...

, mirroring the module path) and that 

<template>/js

 must not contain test or dev-only files.

The AGENTS.md statement that Vitest is used only for React widgets is corrected to match the 

tests/

 convention.

## Resources

- [PR #43773 (test placed inside 00/js, merged 2026-08-27)](https://github.com/shoptet/cms4/pull/43773)
- [PR #43944 (revert)](https://github.com/shoptet/cms4/pull/43944)
- [PR #43950 (re-land with the test under frontend_templates/tests/, includes the publish-script analysis)](https://github.com/shoptet/cms4/pull/43950)
- Publish script: [tools/release/st-deploy-publish-templates-assets](https://github.com/shoptet/cms4/blob/master/tools/release/st-deploy-publish-templates-assets)
- Workflow: [.github/workflows/publish-templates-assets.yaml](https://github.com/shoptet/cms4/blob/master/.github/workflows/publish-templates-assets.yaml)
- Public mirror: [github.com/shoptet/templates-assets](https://github.com/shoptet/templates-assets)

## Technical notes

Verified on 2026-09-21: the script's sync loop copies only the four folders listed above and its final `find` deletes only `*.css` and `*.json`. Both `react/` and `tests/` are outside its reach. Hardening the script to also drop `*.test.js` is release tooling (Purple team) and deliberately out of scope here.

_Generated by Claude Fable 5.1, 2026-09-21_
